device_entry.description: 用于实验设备通信的非物理软件组件。它为串口对象提供加锁与同步访问能力，并封装常见的串口读写操作，以便多个上层设备模块安全地共享同一串口连接。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software component used in laboratory device communication. It provides locking and synchronized access around a serial object and exposes common serial read/write operations so multiple higher-level device modules can safely share the same serial connection.
